product_metadata.title: Alpine Corporation 13" H Indoor Large Hanging Christmas Ball Ornament Decoration with Chasing LED Lights, Silver
features: FESTIVE DECORATION: Hanging Christmas Ball Ornament is the perfect festive addition to your indoor holiday decor
LED LIGHTS: Ball ornament features 240 silver chasing LED lights for a bright display
DURABLE: Constructed of metal and plastic for lasting use
SAFE TO USE: Features a UL listed plug-in adaptor to ensure safe use
IDEAL SIZE: Ball ornament measures 12" x 12" x 13", perfect for your holiday décor
description: Upgrade your holiday decor with Alpine's Hanging Christmas Ball Ornaments! This green ornament is perfect for your festive display. It features 240 silver chasing LED lights for stunning lighting effects to brighten your home. Turn it on to add a colorful flavor to your Christmas tree, creating a fascinating display. It includes a plug-in power source that is UL listed adaptor (Input:120V, 60Hz, Output: 5V). Constructed of durable metal and plastic, this ornament is built for lasting use. Hang around your home or on your Christmas tree! Alpine's Hanging Christmas Ball Ornament measures 12" x 12" x 13", perfect for your holiday decorations.
